response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, technically strong software craftsman with 19+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and developer tooling (test runners, CI/CD, assertion libraries), which aligns well with the 'engineering productivity' technical focus. However, this role is fundamentally a people-management position, and his resume shows no evidence of managing people, running one-on-ones, setting team performance expectations, or leading organizational change — every title held is an individual-contributor role (Developer/Senior/Staff), with leadership limited to community workshops and open-source project ownership.
strengths: Deep, broad technical expertise including developer tooling (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD setup) directly relevant to engineering productivity focus
Extensive experience mentoring and teaching via workshops, talks, and courses (Selenium course, Web Internals, TDT workshops)
Strong system design and cross-domain experience (web, mobile, embedded, low-latency services) suggesting solid technical judgment for guiding architecture
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience — no direct reports, performance reviews, or team-leadership titles anywhere in 19-year history
No evidence of leading organizational change within a company context, only community/education initiatives
Limited recent mobile-platform depth — mobile experience (iOS/Apple TV) is over a decade old and brief

key_factors.factor: All-IC career history with no formal team leadership title
